home.description: Turn documents into a typed world, compress it into finite Markov kernels, and forecast what happens next with explicit uncertainty.

forecast.name: Forecast & simulate
forecast.description: Define scenarios with half-open interventions, run forecasts, and follow run progress.

report.name: Report
report.description: Read outcome distributions by horizon, baseline against intervention, NLL and Brier scores, and validation status. Absent calibration reads "missing", never a number.

interaction.name: Interaction
interaction.description: Ask what-if questions, inspect mechanisms, and explore rank and influence diagnostics.

report.title: Report
report.description: Forecast distributions by horizon, baseline against intervention, the server's statements, the assumptions, and the validation status of one report.
report.notExample: The offline example has no report with this id.

interaction.title: Interaction
interaction.description: What-if re-runs, run comparison, the mechanism inspector, and rank and influence diagnostics for this report's project.

effect.note: Computed by surgery on the stated model: the intervened inputs are held at their values and every other mechanism is unchanged. It is a model-based result, not an effect identified from data.

chart.title: {variable} of {entity}: distribution by horizon step
chart.summary: Probability of each outcome on a fixed 0 to 100% axis, one panel per horizon step.

rules.input: An intervention holds an input variable at one value from its domain. It sets an input, never the outcome being forecast.
rules.window: Each window is half-open, [start, end): the value holds for the transitions start→start+1 through end−1→end. End must be greater than start and at most the horizon.
rules.unavailable: Mechanism replacement and policy replacement are not available yet; only hard assignments run.

form.dropped: Left out of the request because they cannot be edited here: {kinds}.
form.noInterventions: No interventions: the request is an observational forecast.

errors.target: Choose a target entity and variable.
errors.targetKind: This variable is not registered for the entity's kind.
errors.horizon: The horizon must be a whole number of at least 1.
errors.horizonMax: The horizon must be at most {max}, the model's horizon.
errors.scenario: Use letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
errors.variable: Choose a variable registered in the model.
errors.outcome: This would set the forecast target itself. Intervene on an input instead.
errors.entity: Choose an entity whose kind has this variable.
errors.value: Choose a value from the domain.
errors.outOfDomain: {value} is not in this variable's domain for the entity's kind.
errors.windowInteger: Start and end must be whole numbers, with start at least 0.
errors.windowInverted: End ({end}) must be greater than start ({start}): the window [start, end) is half-open.
errors.windowHorizon: End ({end}) must not exceed the horizon ({horizon}).
errors.blocked: Fix the marked fields; nothing was sent.

uncertainty.heading: Uncertainty
uncertainty.noInterval: No interval is drawn: an exact calculation from assumed kernels has no measured spread, and a zero-width band would overstate certainty.

errors.notCompiled: The model is not compiled. Compile it in step 2, then run the forecast.
errors.rejected: The server rejected this forecast request
errors.conflict: The project changed while the request was sent (conflict)

statements.heading: Statements
statements.verbatim: Shown exactly as the server wrote them. Each describes probability mass in this model, not a probability about the actual world.

metrics.heading: Validation metrics
metrics.impossible: An observed outcome was assigned zero probability.
metrics.note: A metric that was not measured reads "missing" (for example, when no backtest exists); it is never shown as 0.

sourceBacked.heading: Source-backed observations
sourceBacked.note: Counted apart from the assumptions above: these records come from sources; the assumptions do not.
